text: タマムシデパートって　このおみせの　なんばいも　おおきい　って　ホント？

structure.jp: タマムシデパートって
このおみせの　なんばいも

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.span: タマムシデパートって
patterns.explanation: って after a noun is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you are about to talk about. タマムシデパートって = 'Celadon Department Store, you know...'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: This って is the casual form of と and wraps up what people say. おおきい　って = '(they say) that it's bigger'.

patterns.name: 〜も (emphasis)
patterns.explanation: も after a 'how many' word means 'many', stressing that the amount is large. なんばいも = 'many times over'.
